APPROVED
BOARD OF GOVERNORS
Provider Relations Advisory Committee
Meeting Minutes – November 20, 2024
1055 W. 7th Street, Los Angeles, CA 90017

Members present: George Greene (Chairperson), Sabra Matovsky (Vice Chairperson), Richard Ayoub, Stephanie Booth, MD, Hector Flores, MD, Monica Gutierrez-McCarthy, Alice Kou, MD, Ashkan Moazzez, MD, Zahra Movaghar, John Raffoul, Amanda Ruiz, MD, David Silver, MD, David Topper, Michelle Tyson, MD, Haig Youredjian.
Management/Staff: John Baackes (CEO), Augustavia Haydel (General Counsel), Sameer Amin (CMO), Noah Paley (Chief of Staff), Acacia Reed (COO).

CALL TO ORDER: The meeting was called to order at 9:37 A.M. by Sabra Matovsky.
APPROVE MEETING AGENDA: The agenda was approved unanimously.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: None.
APPROVE MEETING MINUTES: The August 21, 2024 minutes were approved.

CHAIRPERSON'S REPORT: Chairperson Greene thanked the committee and congratulated retiring CEO John Baackes for his service and for creating the PRAC.

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER'S REPORT: John Baackes discussed the approval of Proposition 35 in California, providing significant funding for Medi-Cal. He reported that L.A. Care is in strong financial shape with approximately $1.5 billion in reserves. He expressed concerns about the new federal administration's stance on Medicaid and the ACA.

DHCS & RATES: Discussion regarding DHCS rate claw backs ($280,000 from 2023) based on member acuity data. L.A. Care is advocating for the use of more current data rather than three-year look-backs.

PROVIDER PORTAL PREVIEW: Geoffrey Paul Vitrano demonstrated the new L.A. Care provider portal scheduled for launch in late December 2024, featuring real-time eligibility, authorizations, and claims status.

TRANSPORTATION (CALL THE CAR): Noah Paley presented performance data for Call The Car (CTC). CTC is performing above metrics in six of eight categories. Efforts are underway to onboard supplemental transportation vendors to handle volume.
